# Auctores

> Auctores is an open-access academic publisher providing peer-reviewed multidisciplinary journals across science, technology, engineering, and medical research with transparent publication ethics and global research dissemination.

Auctores operates as an international open-access publisher aligned with Budapest Open Access Initiative principles, offering manuscript submission platforms, editorial guidelines, and Creative Commons licensing for researchers worldwide. The platform spans diverse research domains including neurology, biomedical sciences, cancer research, and clinical medicine.

## Core Publishing Platform

- [Auctores Home](https://auctoresonline.org): Open-access publisher homepage promoting peer-reviewed research dissemination
- [Publishing In Auctores Journals](https://auctoresonline.org/journals): Directory of multidisciplinary peer-reviewed journals across science, technology, and engineering
- [About Auctores](https://auctoresonline.org/about): Mission statement, ethics standards, and COPE compliance information

## Author & Submission Resources

- [Submit Manuscript](https://auctoresonline.org/submit-manuscript): Manuscript submission platform and process for the global scientific community
- [Author Guidelines](https://auctoresonline.org/authors): Comprehensive author guidelines covering submission policies, open access, and peer review
- [Article Submission Guidelines](https://auctoresonline.org/article-submission-guidelines): Detailed manuscript preparation and submission guidelines across journal categories
- [Article Processing Charges](https://auctoresonline.org/article-processing-charges): Publication cost information and article processing charge details for authors

## Editorial & Peer Review Standards

- [Editor Guidelines](https://auctoresonline.org/editors): Editorial responsibilities and guidelines for journal editors and peer reviewers
- [Open Peer Review](https://auctoresonline.org/open-peer-review): Open peer review process guidelines and quality control standards
- [Publication Ethics](https://auctoresonline.org/publication-ethics): Publication ethics standards, plagiarism policy, and research integrity guidelines

## Open Access & Licensing

- [Open Access Philosophy](https://auctoresonline.org/open-access): Open access principles aligned with Budapest Open Access Initiative standards
- [Reprints & Permissions](https://auctoresonline.org/reprintsPermissions): Creative Commons licensing and article reuse permissions guidelines

## Research Articles

- [Mind Is Not the Brain: Understanding the Distinction between Mental and Neural Realities](https://auctoresonline.org/article/mind-is-not-the-brain-understanding-the-distinction-between-mental-and-neural-realities): Research article on mind-brain distinction, consciousness, and cognitive science
- [Neuroprotective Potential of Cinnamon: Mechanistic Insights and Experimental Evidence](https://auctoresonline.org/article/neuroprotective-potential-of-cinnamon-mechanistic-insights-and-experimental-evidence): Research on cinnamon's neuroprotective effects against neurodegenerative diseases
- [Acetaminophen's Impact on Skeletal Muscles in Young Adults](https://auctoresonline.org/article/acetaminophens-impact-on-skeletal-muscles-in-young-adults): Clinical research on acetaminophen effects on skeletal muscle strength in youth
- [Bidirectional Two-Sample Mendelian Randomization Study Investigating Gut Microbiota and Kawasaki Disease](https://auctoresonline.org/article/bidirectional-two-sample-mendelian-randomization-study-investigating-gut-microbiota-and-kawasaki-disease): Genetic study on causal relationship between gut microbiota and Kawasaki disease
- [Physical Exercises Trailblazer Effects on Body Systems](https://auctoresonline.org/article/physical-exercises-trailblazer-effects-on-body-systems): Clinical review of physical exercise effects on health and body systems
